x: Of our three entrants, Mal Robinson finished a close second to P. Milner (Walton) in 4-17.2; Alan Black was 5th in the same heat with 4-23.6 and Eric Penny, in a later heat, 8th in 4-38.5.

Meanwhile our own Pat Newell, not in the least deterred by the class of the opposition, was putting pressure upon Peter Milner of Walton and ended up in third position only 45 secs. behind T.V.H. and 29 secs. ahead of Walton.

John Thresher came next and consolidated our second place by running right away from Peter Milner. He also could make no ground on the leaders wh[illegible] were represented by David Cooke and at the end of this stage, with only one lap to go, Portsmouth were over 2½ minutes ahead.
